sections.Profile:
The "Yukon" pinball machine, released by Williams in 1971, is a single-player electro-mechanical game designed by Norm Clark with artwork by Christian Marche. Notable for its Canadian gold rush theme, it features two flippers, five pop bumpers, and three kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1971
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Prospecting, Canadian West, Single Player, Western, Gold, Original Theme, 1970s
